grounding_visual.name: Visual Grounding
grounding_visual.description: Focus on immediate environment to reduce anxiety

steps.action: Look around and name 5 things you can see
steps.detail: Take your time, describe colors or shapes

steps.action: Focus on one object and describe it in detail
Notice the lighting in your space
Find something that brings you calm to look at
steps.detail: A photo, plant, or calming object

breathing_box.name: Box Breathing
breathing_box.description: Structured breathing to regulate nervous system

steps.action: Breathe in for 4 counts
Hold breath for 4 counts
Exhale for 4 counts
Repeat the full cycle 3 times

PMR_hand.name: Hand Progressive Relaxation
PMR_hand.description: Release tension through guided muscle relaxation

steps.action: Make fists with both hands for 5 seconds
Release and notice the relaxation for 10 seconds
steps.detail: Feel the contrast between tense and relaxed

steps.action: Flex your wrists upward for 5 seconds
Let hands rest naturally and breathe
Notice your current worried thought
Ask: Is this thought helpful right now?
Think of one small thing you can control
Focus on that controllable action

mindful_pause.name: Mindful Pause
mindful_pause.description: Brief mindfulness to interrupt anxiety cycles

steps.action: Pause whatever you're doing for 10 seconds
Take 3 deeper breaths than usual
steps.detail: Don't force it, just slightly deeper

steps.action: Notice your feet touching the ground
Set a small intention for the next few minutes
steps.detail: One simple thing you want to do
